Reference fixture provenance (spec §8.9)
=========================================

This directory is reserved for byte-level reference DBF/CDX/FPT files
produced by real tools (dBase III+, FoxPro 2.6a DOS, VFP 9 SP2) on
real-period hardware or reference VMs. Each committed file MUST have an
entry here listing: producing tool and version, originator, date, and
redistribution permission. CI refuses compatibility tests when a listed
file is missing, and files without provenance must never be committed.

Status at M1: no external reference files are committed yet. The
conformance suite uses the synthetic generated fixtures in
testdata/gen/ (regenerable via tests/gen_fixtures.py equivalent
testdata/gen/gen_fixtures.py), which follow docs/formats.md exactly.

Planned entries (to be filled when real fixtures are contributed):
  # people_fox26.dbf  — FoxPro 2.6a for DOS, CREATE TABLE + APPEND, 2025-xx-xx
  # people_dbase3.dbf — dBase III+ 1.0, ...
  # people_vfp9.dbf   — VFP 9 SP2, ...
